description: This file defines the LinkRenderer class responsible for rendering hyperlinks within Markdown content, handling internal and external URLs, and resolving links based on project configurations.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A class that implements rendering of Markdown links, resolving internal and external URLs, and applying appropriate attributes based on link type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LinkRenderer with configuration and sets up the parent renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render method that processes a Node object representing a link, resolving URLs, and setting appropriate attributes for external, internal, or broken links.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the renderer by delegating to the parent renderer.
